description: Owner ruling D-11 (editing the business profile is OWNER only, regardless of granted scopes) holds on the two routes beside PATCH /identity/businesses/:businessId that wrote owner-only Business fields (R0-09 review R09-ST-2, R09-ST-3). PUT /site/presence/businesses/:businessId/draft refuses a non-owner a slug that is neither Business.slug nor the draft's own, and POST .../publish refuses a non-owner whose draft slug differs from Business.slug: 403 {code:'PRESENCE_SLUG_OWNER_ONLY'}, nothing written; other presence edits keep the BusinessGuard rule (any member) and a publish that keeps the slug no longer rewrites the Business row. POST /onboarding-concierge/businesses/:businessId/auto-configure is OWNER only as a whole (every call rewrites Business.metaData; it also writes name, businessHours, storeEnabled and a missing slug): 403 {code:'BUSINESS_PROFILE_OWNER_ONLY'}, Business row byte-identical, no product created. The owner (OWNER membership or Business.ownerId, the rule IdentityService.assertBusinessOwner applies) and SUPER_ADMIN (the BusinessGuard platform bypass) still succeed. Run from apps/server against this packet's isolated, migrated database: npx vitest run test/d11-sibling-writes.integration.test.ts --reporter=json --outputFile=.proof/r0-09b-vitest.json, then node ../../scripts/proof-admission/evaluate.mjs --manifest ../../scripts/proof-admission/manifests/d11-sibling-writes.json --report .proof/r0-09b-vitest.json. Cases tagged RED-BEFORE fail on the unmodified code (the R0 working branch at a230d7fc; the tests-first commit 03329b28 records the tally: 7 failed, 8 passed).
notes: Owner-only fields are the ones PATCH /identity/businesses/:businessId writes (R0-09): name, slug, currency, timezone, tax, store settings, businessHours, metaData and the rest of UpdateBusinessDto. The presence routes put only slug on the Business row; branding, sections, seo and customDomain live in site_page_drafts / site_pages_published, so those edits were not tightened (cases S04, S05).

The owner rule is restated in PresenceService.assertSlugOwner and OnboardingConciergeService.assertProfileOwner rather than imported from IdentityService, as R0-08c did: IdentityModule imports AiModule, which reaches SiteModule through KeyCortexModule, and neither feature module file is in this packet's write set.
The spawned-server suite identity-boundary.integration.test.ts no longer carries the two it.todo entries for R09-ST-2 and R09-ST-3; R09-ST-4 and CR-3 remain open there for their own packets.
